_comment: B2 offline forecasting experiment. Every setting here must be fixed BEFORE results are seen. Values marked default_pending_review were proposed by the developer and need team sign-off; the acceptance rule is deliberately null until the team sets it.
seed_basis: same seed as the existing ml/train.py
predict_basis: models predict change from the current value (delta); level = current + delta. Trees cannot extrapolate levels.
timezone_basis: same zone as the scheduled Cloud Functions in functions/index.js

sufficiency._comment: A day counts as independent when at least this % of its 5-min bins have a usable target. Required days are derived from the split settings below.

splits._comment: Gap between train and validation/test = max(horizon, min_gap_minutes). The final test period is the last test_days local calendar days and is used once.

hottest_hours._comment: the k local hours with the highest mean target in the TRAINING data

retrain._comment: null = retrain only on an admin request. To schedule, have an external scheduler (cron, Railway cron, Cloud Scheduler) run `python -m forecast.retrain run --latest`. A run never deploys a model.

acceptance_rule_template._comment: Copy to acceptance_rule and fill in BEFORE running on real data. null fields are not checked.
